profile.headline: Senior iOS Software Engineer | Impiricus
profile.summary: I'm a sales professional turned iOS Software Engineer 5+ years ago. I've built and led native iOS applications professionally since 2019 for millions of users. I excel in cross-functional teams ranging from all experience levels where I have opportunities to learn from peers, as well as take mentorship roles.

positions.title: Co-Founder
positions.description:
Created a 10-week curriculum in iOS development with custom video & articles.
Mentor students through live calls, workshops, and code review.
Organize events inviting iOS Developers to share advice and experiences with students.

positions.title: Senior iOS Software Engineer
positions.description:
Provisioned and released 10 native iOS applications to the App Store.
Maintain consistent code styling and quality of code as a code reviewer.
Drove and developed the addition of deep linking.
Implemented a Dark Web Monitoring service, allowing users to be notified when their PII is found on the Dark Web.
Led weekly sprint planning meetings that involved iOS, Android, Web, and QA teams

positions.title: iOS Software Engineer
positions.description:
Maintain 80% minimum unit test coverage.
Support consistent codebase styling by following styleguides and existing app architectures.
Build UI using Interface Builder and Programmatic UI.
Adhere to agile methodology.

positions.title: Programming Technician
positions.description:
Designed and updated pages of the company website using WordPress.
Supported development in a web app that displays university hour credits automatically obtained for specific military job positions.
Contributed code in a multiple developer codebase with Git as version control.

positions.title: Renewal Sales  Rep
positions.description:
Cultivated relationships through outbound phone and email with account managers in order to renew software licenses for their accounts.
Corporate experience using CRM software and outbound calls/emails.
Established software license renewals by leading WebEx meetings to initiate the renewal process of Cisco products.
Responsible for a pipeline of 500+ accounts.
